text.title: Growth Referral Programs Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable referral-programme signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Can the landing page and lifecycle email infrastructure accept and persist a per-user referral parameter, and is there a measured NPS from the last 90 days?

conclusion.verdict: no way to attribute referrals; build the referral parameter path first

branch.when: referral_param_infra == true AND (nps_measured_90d == false OR nps < 30)

conclusion.verdict: measure NPS on active users; do not launch below 30

branch.when: referral_param_infra == true AND nps_measured_90d == true AND nps >= 30
branch.question: Which programme-design signal fails on inspection of the spec, the landing page, the emails and the fraud guard?

conclusion.verdict: fire the prompt on a named value event and record its reach
release rewards on a qualifying purchase or activation with a stated minimum
make it double-sided and show reward cost against CAC and margin

branch.when: self_referral_matching == false OR reward_idempotency_key == false OR reward_hold == false

conclusion.verdict: add self-referral matching, a reward hold and the idempotency tuple before launch

branch.when: k_invites < 500 OR k_referrers < 50 OR (k < 1 AND described_as_viral == true)

conclusion.verdict: do not report K yet, or present it as a 1/(1-K) multiplier net of reward cost
issue per-user codes and persist the link at referee account creation

branch.when: announcement_at_trigger == false OR reminder_to_referrers == true OR confirmation_email == false

conclusion.verdict: announcement at trigger, one reminder to zero-referral users only, confirmation to both sides
disclose the reward on shared content and publish programme terms
emit the spec artefact; surface ready_for_review=true

text.example: referral_param_infra=true, nps=42 (measured 30 days ago) -> trigger_event=first_successful_export, reward_released_on=first_paid_order, double_sided=true, reward_per_qualified_referee=40 vs paid_cac=95, self_referral_matching=true, reward_idempotency_key=true, k_invites=4200, k=0.74, per_user_code=true, confirmation_email=true, terms_published=true -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
